title: 3-Day Athletic PowerBuilding
author: Fishmilk
desc:
Weekly programming recommendation:

1. Upper, 
2. Mats + Burpees, 
3. Mats, 
4. Lower, 
5. Full Body, 
6. Mats, 
7. Mats,

All movements have two working sets. however strength work will be preceded by 1-2 warmup sets. 

Strength working sets will have a top set at max weight, and a backoff set at 0.9xTS weight and higher reps. hypertrophy work sets will be straight sets with the same weight and rep range. 

strength uses top set double progression. hypertrophy uses double progression on both sets.

All reps are performed explosively with controlled eccentric. Certain movements also contain an iso hold finisher for tendon development. Read the notes for every exercise. 

Designed for Combat athletes looking to build Strength, Hypertrophy and Explosive Power. Sport specific endurance, cardio and movements are generally assumed to be covered separately by sparring on the mats. 

The three training days cover:

Upper day- Strength, conditioning and hypertrophy
Lower day- Strength, Hypertrophy, Functionality, conditioning 
Full body day- Explosiveness, speed, hypertrophy

ex.note:
Maximal pressing strength, upper body mass, neurological adaption. 

TSDP. 2 warmup sets. No rest between warmup sets, 3 mins rest.

Upper back hypertrophy, scapular strength, posture, grappling carryover. Neural day

Finish w Kelso shrugs to failure. 

TSDP. 2 warmup sets. No rest between warmup sets, 3 mins rest otherwise

OHP maintenance and hypertrophy. Calculate weight by previous week's TS weight x 0.82

No warmup sets needed. 3m rest.

Maintenance and hypertrophy vertical pull. Calculate weight by previous week's TS weight x 0.82

No warmup sets needed. 3m rest

30-45s dead hang after final set.

ss.note:
Speed piston reps, no lockout. Try to complete as many rounds of the circuit as you can within 10min. Log rounds in "reps"

Unilateral leg drive and endurance, isometric clamping strength and stamina

Upper body endurance and integrity for strong frames and creating space

On knuckles for wrist stability and comfort.
Explosive hip-hinge power for sprawls and takedowns, and lower back stamina

Takedown, pulling and grip stamina, wrist strength, squeeze power for chokes 

Pull yourself halfway up a chin-up, then repeatedly switch your grips from supinated to pronated. 1rep= both hands switch

Framing and striking guard stamina

For one single rep, speed press horizontally out in front of you whilst standing up, then retract and speed press overhead and back down. Feet can hop to stabilise
Neck bridge on ground, nodding motion
Hold the rear neck bridge on the ground or on a box, for 30sec

Forearm flexor and extensor hypertrophy, tendon strength and resilience. 

Alternate between front of body extensions and behind the body curls. 

DP. Use heavier weight for curls

Use a lighter weight for extensions. 

On the second set of both wrist movements, hold an isometric for 30-45s for tendon development.

ex.note: max crushing strength, strength volume, endurance backoff, 30-40sec iso. rest by switching hands. each set one increment below the former (except iso, same as s3). Do on way home. 1xweek, recoverable

ss.note:
Shoulder stability and strength, full kinetic chain strength.

3 reps per side. Heavy as possible. Pause  and tense for 1s at each position on the eccentric. 

You may rest up to 1m after each double.
Lateral power and stability, gluteus minimus rehab, ankle stiffness. Stick every landing for 2 seconds. Rest 1-2m. 3 per leg.

ex.note:
Lower body strength, takedown base, trunk rigidity. 

2 warmup sets. Rest 3-5min. TSP. No rest between warmup sets. x0.9 BO

Posterior-chain strength, hip extension power, hamstring development. 

1 ws. 3min rest. TSP. No rest between warmup sets.

Anti-lateral flexion trunk strength, asymmetrical stability. Crushing grip strength and endurance, lateral wrist rigidity. no straps

2min rest. Suitcase-carry, 1 sided. right, left, rest. 30-45s, DP

rectus femoris hypertrophy and strength. 

precede working set with a 30s 75% isometric at 3/4 ROM. then short rest and start

Explosive contraction, controlled eccentric. Lean back, deep stretch. DP

Knee flexion strength and hamstring durability, hypertrophy. 

quick warmup set. 1-2min rest. DP. 

Seated is better if possible. first set just a warmup. After final set, 30s long lever bridge iso

whole calf hypertrophy, both soleus and gastro equally. 

Only do bottom half of the ROM. 30s toes up stretched iso

Footwork rhythm, elastic conditioning, lower-leg durability, shoulder endurance, aerobic recovery. 

Continuous low intensity. Vary technique. No rest. 

Finish with 50 Tibialis Anterior raises, bw

ss.note:
Max effort sprints. Hill sprints if possible. 2mins rest.

Maximal horizontal acceleration and single leg power. Lower body plyometric chain.

First warmup with knee ups, heel ups, leg swings, 70% run

Reactive elasticity and speed, explosive pushing power, striking carryover. 
30s rest between sets.

Each pushup begins with dropping from a height of a few inches, immediately rebound from the floor.

Pressing volume. Chest hypertrophy. 

1-2min rest. DP. 0-1RIR

Stand on outer feet between sets to work tendon

Chest hypertrophy volume. Go near failure 0-1RIR

After final set hold 30s iso for tendon development

ex.note:
lats and Biceps hypertrophy.

2min rest. close supinated grip

ss.note:
Upper back hypertrophy, scapular endurance, rear delts, rotator cuff, pulling volume. 

1-2min rest. DP. 

scapular retraction at start of every rep. squeeze peak and slow eccentric. 30-45s iso after

Abdominal hypertrophy/stamina/strength, hip flexors and tendon 

use a weight plate and DP

Between sets, do 30 degree bicep tendon isos, calisthenics style

ex.note:
Tricep overall hypertrophy, long head specification. 1-2min rest

After final set hold 30s 1/2 ROM iso for tendon development

ss.note:
Medial delt hypertrophy, shoulder durability and volume. 

DP. Use straps to focus fully on delt. 

Cheat a little to get the concentric, then control the eccentric for 2-3s.

Alternate between neck flexion and extension, using plates as weight. 

no rest, just switch movements. use lighter weight on neck curls than neck extensions.
Use a heavier weight for extensions. No rest between sets, just switch movements.
